paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different relation popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The line chart illustrates the relationship between "Answer Popularity" and three variables: "Accuracy," "Confidence," and "Alignment," for Llama3-8B on songs, showing how these metrics change across different levels of answer popularity. The X-axis, labeled "Answer Popularity," has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 160, with evenly spaced numerical labels at intervals of 20, starting from 20 and ending at 160. The Y-axis, labeled "Values," also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with numerical labels at intervals of 0.2. Three distinct lines are plotted on the graph, each representing one of the variables. The blue line, representing "Accuracy," starts at approximately 0.3 when the "Answer Popularity" is 10, initially decreases to around 0.2 at a popularity of 20, then increases to about 0.65 at a popularity of 90 before decreasing again to roughly 0.35 at a popularity of 120, and finally rising to approximately 0.5 at a popularity of 150. The green line, representing "Confidence," begins at around 0.8 when the "Answer Popularity" is 10, dips slightly to about 0.7 at a popularity of 20, and then generally increases to approximately 0.9 at a popularity of 150, with some fluctuations in between. The red line, representing "Alignment," starts at roughly 0.55 when the "Answer Popularity" is 10, decreases slightly to around 0.5 at a popularity of 20, rises to a peak of about 0.8 at a popularity of 90, and then decreases to approximately 0.55-0.6 at a popularity of 150.
